system.description:
Reavers Quarry – Reaver Echo.

You have been struck, but the damage seems to have been delayed. When it triggers, it detonates like a bomb with deep gashes, slashes, puncture wounds and kinetic impacts that seem to manifest as a punishment. Reaver Echo is treated as a Physical condition.

Reaver Echoes detonate if one of the following occurs: You move 10 or more feet on a turn. You make one or more attacks. You would force two or more creatures to make a saving throw as a result of jutsu you cast or feature/trait you use.

When Reaver Echoes are detonated, you take 1d12 Piercing or slashing damage (The Reavers choice) for every Reaver Echo detonated.

When Reaver Echoes are detonated, you lose all generated stacks of them and they cannot be reapplied again until the end of the current turn.
system.summary: Stacks; detonates if it moves 10+ ft, attacks, or forces two or more creatures to save: 1d12 piercing or slashing per Echo, then all are lost.

rules.text: Detonation: roll 1d12 per Echo (piercing or slashing, the Reaver's choice), then remove all Echoes; none can be reapplied until the end of that turn.
